source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
A unit that heals or regains wounds gets back up to that many lost wounds, 1 at a time:

- If any of its models is missing wounds, pick one; it regains 1.
- Otherwise, if any of its models is **destroyed**, revive 1 that is not a **CHARACTER**, with 1 wound left.

No model ends up with more wounds than at the start of the battle.

If a rule heals one model, or has it regain wounds, only that model regains them, up to its starting wounds; extra wounds are lost and revive no destroyed model.
